"""Continue authenticated independent v4 histories; retain only new raw paths."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
source=Path('/tmp/a1-body-radau3-solved-genesis-20260927.py').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()=='6f6999a513f752fb5c23946cde660ddadac5de2e86bd39302255fd4110f13636'
marker='\nresult=dict(schema=SCHEMA,completed=False'
assert source.decode().count(marker)==1
exec(compile(source.decode().split(marker,1)[0],'<accepted v4 motion and observer>','exec'))

SCHEMA='guala.functional-body.radau3-continuation.v1'
assert len(sys.argv)==3
parent_name,parent_sha=sys.argv[1:]
assert Path(parent_name).name==parent_name and parent_name.endswith('.json')
assert len(parent_sha)==64 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in parent_sha)
result=dict(schema=SCHEMA,completed=False,failure=None,mounted=False,full_body_qualification=False,
    continuum_enclosure=False,intrinsic_couple_impulse_qualified=False,
    parent_receipt=dict(file=parent_name,sha256=parent_sha),resumed_inputs=[],
    scope='current-law independent histories continued without prefix replay or synchronization',
    checkpoints={},common_samples=[],common_sample_count=0,last_common_time_s=None,
    prior_attempts=0,prior_calls=0,prior_numerical_cpu_seconds=0.,
    prefix_qualified=False,history_resumable=False,
    limits=dict(trials=MAX_TRIALS,per_interval_trials=LOCAL_TRIALS,cpu_seconds=CPU_LIMIT))
lanes,errors=[],Errors()


def load_parent():
    b=Path('docs/evidence',parent_name).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==parent_sha
    receipt=json.loads(b)
    assert receipt['measurement_recorded'] and receipt['health_error'] is None
    assert receipt['operational_error'] is None and not receipt['execution']['timed_out']
    p=receipt['raw_measurement'];b=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(p['payload_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
    assert len(b)==p['raw_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==p['raw_sha256']
    parent=json.loads(b)
    assert parent['schema'] in ('guala.functional-body.radau3-solved-genesis.v1',SCHEMA)
    assert not parent['completed'] and parent['first_failure'] is None
    assert parent['failure']['type']=='RuntimeError'
    assert parent['failure']['error']=='bounded admitted-motion diagnostic exhausted; qualification incomplete'
    assert parent['event_agreement']['status'] in ('PASS','PENDING')
    for label,value in parent['metrics'].items():
        assert value['status']==('UNQUALIFIED' if label=='intrinsic_couple_impulse' else 'PASS')
    if parent['schema']==SCHEMA:
        assert parent['history_resumable'] and parent['prefix_qualified']
        result.update(common_sample_count=parent['common_sample_count'],
            last_common_time_s=parent['last_common_time_s'])
    else:
        assert parent['identical_initial_physical_state']
        result.update(common_sample_count=len(parent['common_samples']),
            last_common_time_s=parent['common_samples'][-1])
    result.update(checkpoints=parent['checkpoints'],event_agreement=parent['event_agreement'],
        prior_attempts=parent.get('prior_attempts',0)+parent['attempts'],
        prior_calls=parent.get('prior_calls',0)+parent['calls'],
        prior_numerical_cpu_seconds=parent.get('prior_numerical_cpu_seconds',0.)+parent['cpu_seconds'])
    metrics=parent['metrics']
    errors.groups={label:value['channels'] for label,value in metrics.items() if 'channels' in value}
    for label,rows in errors.groups.items():
        for name,row in rows.items():
            if row['ratio']>errors.worst_ratio:
                errors.worst_ratio=row['ratio']
                errors.worst_failure=dict(metric=label,channel=name,time_us=row['time_us'],ratio=row['ratio'])
    touch=metrics['local_tactile_correspondence']
    errors.unresolved_touch={k:touch[k] for k in ('samples','first','last')}
    errors.matched_touch_points=touch['matched_points'];errors.empty_touch_samples=touch['both_empty_samples']
    errors.couple_impulse=metrics['intrinsic_couple_impulse']['pairs']
    # Keep only exact continuation state, cumulative physical totals and event
    # correspondence. Bulky accepted/refused predecessor paths remain solely
    # in the content-addressed parent, not copied into the new receipt.
    keep=('label','nominal_dt_s','genesis_base64','time_s','state_base64','remaining_supply_j',
          'work','observation','observation_error','release','event_correspondence','impulses',
          'trials','reused')
    saved=[]
    for lane in parent['lanes']:
        last=lane['last_attempt']
        assert last is not None
        if last['completed']:
            assert last['end_s']==lane['time_s']
        else:
            assert last['rollback_exact'] and last['start_s']==lane['time_s']
            assert last['predecessor_base64']==lane['state_base64']
            assert last['supply_j']==lane['remaining_supply_j']
        compact={k:lane[k] for k in keep}
        compact['last_attempt']={k:last[k] for k in
            ('completed','start_s','end_s','predecessor_base64','supply_j','rollback_exact') if k in last}
        saved.append(compact)
    return saved


def resume_lane(saved,control):
    assert saved['observation_error'] is None
    lane=Lane(saved['label'],saved['nominal_dt_s'],control);c=lane.c
    assert lane.genesis==saved['genesis_base64']
    raw_state=base64.b64decode(saved['state_base64'],validate=True)
    entry=dict(label=lane.label,expected_state_base64=saved['state_base64'],
        expected_time_s=saved['time_s'],expected_observation=saved['observation'],passed=False)
    result['resumed_inputs'].append(entry)
    try:
        interval._restore(c.e,np.frombuffer(raw_state,dtype='<f8').copy(),.0001)
        c.work=tuple(saved['work']);c.supply=saved['remaining_supply_j']
        c.impulses={tuple(r['pair']):(np.asarray(r['force']),np.asarray(r['couple']),
            r['force_path'],r['couple_path']) for r in saved['impulses']}
        lane.last_attempt=saved['last_attempt']
        lane.release=saved['release'];lane.trials=saved['trials'];lane.reused=saved['reused']
        lane.by_key={tuple(r['key']):r['occurrences'] for r in saved['event_correspondence']}
        entry['actual_observation']=asdict(c.e._observation())
        assert primary(c.e)==raw_state and float(c.d.time)==saved['time_s']
        assert json.dumps(entry['actual_observation'],sort_keys=True)==json.dumps(saved['observation'],sort_keys=True)
        assert c.supply>0 and c.work[0]>=0
        entry['passed']=True
        return lane
    finally:
        entry.update(actual_state_base64=raw(primary(c.e)),actual_time_s=float(c.d.time),
            actual_work=c.work,actual_supply_j=c.supply)


def compare_at(stop):
    a,b=(lane.c for lane in lanes)
    assert float(a.d.time)==float(b.d.time)==stop
    result['comparison_in_progress']=dict(time_s=stop,states=[raw(primary(c.e)) for c in (a,b)])
    errors.compare(a,b,a.snapshot(),b.snapshot(),stop*1e6)
    agreement=event_agreement(*lanes,stop);result['event_agreement']=agreement
    if agreement['status']=='FAIL' and 'left' in agreement and 'right' in agreement:
        x,y=agreement['left'],agreement['right']
        ab=tuple(map(F,x['time_exact'])) if 'time_exact' in x else (F(x['start_s']),F(x['end_s']))
        cd=tuple(map(F,y['time_exact'])) if 'time_exact' in y else (F(y['start_s']),F(y['end_s']))
        lower=max(F(0),ab[0]-cd[1],cd[0]-ab[1]);upper=max(ab[1]-cd[0],cd[1]-ab[0])
        result['failed_event_separation']=dict(lower_s=float(lower),upper_s=float(upper),
            proves_excessive_separation=lower>F(EVENT),qualified=upper<=F(EVENT),continuum_enclosure=False)
    if errors.first_failure is not None or errors.unresolved_touch['samples'] or agreement['status'] in ('FAIL','UNRESOLVED'):
        raise ValueError('first current-law whole-motion accuracy or event correspondence failure')
    assert stop>result['last_common_time_s'] and stop-result['last_common_time_s']<=H
    result['common_samples'].append(stop);result['common_sample_count']+=1
    result['last_common_time_s']=stop
    result.pop('comparison_in_progress')
    if len(result['common_samples'])%100==0:
        print('PROGRESS',json.dumps(dict(time_s=stop,attempts=attempts,cpu_seconds=time.process_time()-started_cpu)),flush=True)


mj.mj_forward=forward
try:
    saved_lanes=load_parent();controls=archived_controls()
    assert [r['label'] for r in saved_lanes]==['coarse','half']
    assert [r['nominal_dt_s'] for r in saved_lanes]==[H,H/2]
    for saved in saved_lanes:lanes.append(resume_lane(saved,controls[100]))
    del saved,saved_lanes
    times=[float(l.c.d.time) for l in lanes]
    assert min(times)==result['last_common_time_s'] and max(times)-min(times)<=H
    result['independent_restore_verified']=True
    for boundary in (.048,.25,.5):
        if boundary<min(float(l.c.d.time) for l in lanes):
            assert str(boundary) in result['checkpoints']
            if boundary==.25:assert all(l.release is not None for l in lanes)
            continue
        while min(float(l.c.d.time) for l in lanes)<boundary:
            budget();times=[float(l.c.d.time) for l in lanes]
            stop=max(times) if times[0]!=times[1] else next_sample(times[0],boundary)
            assert result['last_common_time_s']<stop<=boundary
            for lane in lanes:
                if float(lane.c.d.time)<stop:lane.advance(stop)
                else:assert float(lane.c.d.time)==stop
            compare_at(stop)
        assert all(float(l.c.d.time)==boundary for l in lanes)
        result['checkpoints'][str(boundary)]=[dict(time_s=float(l.c.d.time),state_base64=raw(primary(l.c.e)),
            work=l.c.work,remaining_supply_j=l.c.supply) for l in lanes]
        if boundary==.25:
            for lane in lanes:
                if lane.release is not None:continue
                c=lane.c;before=primary(c.e);c.d.ctrl[c.motor]=0.;after=primary(c.e)
                probe.forward(c.e)
                assert primary(c.e)==after and float(c.d.time)==.25
                lane.release=dict(time_s=.25,before_base64=raw(before),after_base64=raw(after))
    if result['event_agreement']['status']!='PASS':raise ValueError('unmatched terminal event; qualification incomplete')
    budget();result['completed']=True
except Exception as error:
    result['failure']=dict(type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc(limit=8))
finally:
    mj.mj_forward=native_forward
    result.update(lanes=[lane.record() for lane in lanes],metrics=errors.result(),first_failure=errors.first_failure,
        attempts=attempts,calls=probe.calls,call_accounting=audit,native_seconds=probe.native_seconds,
        observed_primitive_seconds=probe.transition_seconds,observer_seconds=probe.observer_seconds,
        last_solver=list(probe.steps),cpu_seconds=time.process_time()-started_cpu,wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started_wall)
    result['prefix_qualified']=(result.get('independent_restore_verified',False)
        and errors.first_failure is None and not errors.unresolved_touch['samples']
        and 'comparison_in_progress' not in result and result['event_agreement']['status'] in ('PASS','PENDING'))
    result['history_resumable']=(result['prefix_qualified'] and result['failure'] is not None
        and result['failure']['type']=='RuntimeError'
        and result['failure']['error']=='bounded admitted-motion diagnostic exhausted; qualification incomplete')
    if result['completed'] and (result['cpu_seconds']>=CPU_LIMIT or attempts>=MAX_TRIALS):
        result['completed']=False
        result['failure']=dict(type='BudgetExceeded',error='terminal measured budget exceeded; qualification incomplete')
print(json.dumps(encode(result)),flush=True)
